title: Engine scoreboard: coverage next to quality per exam kind with trend and quality-regression flag (REQ-0069)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 run-stats board prints coverage and quality side by side with delta and verdict
AC2 coverage-up/quality-down flagged with synthetic test
AC3 keyed regression set re-scored and appended to history

design.summary: run-stats board: quality block, kind and pairing by exam hash, per-pair delta, verdict with coverage-up/quality-down flag and unmeasured case, keyed regression set from evals; D5 classify fix

implementation.summary: run-stats board: quality block (attempt-adjusted headline over all keyed), exam kind + pairing by exam hash, per-pair delta, verdict with coverage-up/quality-down flag and unmeasured, review packs scoped per exam; 63.6 regression set split to a follow-up

unit_test.result: 1225 tests, only baseline failures; golden stats/compare/trend byte-identical vs pre-task commit; 5/5 mutations killed; hand-checked 30q (16/30), 2q, 100q, shared-id packs; unmeasured never better

security.result: no finding; board reads no key file, only score written by the scorer

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; run-stats board on saved runs; keyed mock run
verification.result: REQ-0069 AC1, AC2 verified (1225 tests, baseline failures only; golden stats/compare/trend byte-identical; 5/5 mutations killed; 30q gives 16/30; coverage alone never better; unmeasured honest on saved DGNL/trial runs; packs scoped per exam); AC3 split to REQ-0072; limits: key and precision path on a real keyed history line not yet exercised (unit tests only), denominator assumes the key covers unanswered questions, noise rule loose at small n (TASK-064)
